trace.reason: Check whether an error-driven guideline already covers modeling mutually exclusive activity alternatives and their merge.

result.rule: When the description states mutually exclusive alternatives as actions performed by a participant: Model each stated action as a task on its own exclusive branch, rather than as a separate end event. If the alternatives have a shared continuation or completion, join them with an exclusive merge before it.

When the description says that one of several alternatives is selected, or that an activity may occur: Model the choice or optional activity with an appropriate gateway, and reconnect the resulting paths before subsequent common work.

When the description distinguishes mutually exclusive cases by conditions, assigns different actions to them, and later gives them a shared continuation: Model the case selection with an exclusive split, and reconverge the alternative paths with an exclusive merge before the shared continuation.

When the description says that a participant decides at the end of a stated period whether to continue an activity: Model the decision after that period and use an exclusive gateway to route either to continuation work or to completion.

args.text: When the description states that a participant performs an action to send information to another participant, model the action as a task in the sender’s process rather than as a send task.

trace.reason: Check whether a guideline distinguishing the reference task from the generated send task can be stated generally.
